3. The door starts in `open=false` state, so the milestone should detect when it changes to `open=true`.

I can see the closed door from overhead. The door occupies the block at (0, 0, 5) relative to current position. In Minecraft, when a door opens, it stays in the same block position — the block state changes from `open=false` to `open=true`, but the block coordinates don't change. The door visually swings open but remains at the same grid position.
